# 1 Enoch Chapter 107 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Birth of Noah (Appendix)

---

**1** After that I explained to him all the secrets of the book of Enoch and all the parables that had been given to me in them and summed them up for him.

**2** And he departed and called the name of that son Noah; for he will comfort the earth after all the destruction.

**3** Another son was born to him after the flood who was called Nir, and all the secrets of his mystery were shown to Noah concerning the destruction that was approaching during the generation that Nir and his son were to rule over.

---

*LOGOS notes: The etymology of Noah (nuah = to rest, to comfort) provided in v. 2 links this narrative to Genesis 5:29 (Lamech's naming of Noah: "this one shall comfort us in our work"). V. 3's introduction of Nir is unexpected and connects to the Slavonic Enoch tradition (2 Enoch 70–73), where Nir is Methuselah's son and a miraculous priestly figure. The verse may represent a fragment of a larger Noah-Nir tradition.*
